data.description:
Implement plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh.

## Logic
1. source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/deps.sh
2. Read hooks.compliance_verifier.enabled from dso-config.conf; if false/absent exit 0
3. ARTIFACTS_DIR=$(get_artifacts_dir) — must use get_artifacts_dir() from deps.sh for consistency with commit-step.sh
4. First-run guard: if ARTIFACTS_DIR absent, warn to stderr, exit 0
5. Static expected list: [lint] (walking skeleton; Story 3 extends this)
6. If lint.result present → exit 0
   If lint.timeout present → exit 1 with timeout-specific message
   If neither → exit 1 with missing-artifact message
chmod +x after creation.

## Classification
GREEN — make T3 pass.

## Files
- plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh (CREATE)
